lines.zh: 我踩过的下界岩，留下一圈焦黑。
lines.en: Everything I step on leaves a scorched ring.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可每一步都烫。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but every step is hot.

lines.zh: 我的关节是黑石，磨得发亮。
lines.en: My joints are blackstone, worn smooth and bright.

lines.zh: 岩浆从我的裂缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Lava seeps out through the cracks in my body.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，苔藓立刻干枯。
lines.en: Moss dries up the moment I pass it.

lines.zh: 我不看路，火知道该往哪烧。
lines.en: I do not watch the road; the fire knows the way.

lines.zh: 灰烬粘在我肩上，像一层雪。
lines.en: Ash sticks to my shoulders like a layer of snow.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面就响一声。
lines.en: The ground groans once with every step I take.

lines.zh: 我的重量压得下界岩发裂。
lines.en: My weight splits the netherrack beneath me.

lines.zh: 腰里那颗火核，一直在烧。
lines.en: The flame core in my belly never stops burning.

lines.zh: 我朝着热气走，从不朝冷处。
lines.en: I walk toward heat and never toward the cold.

lines.zh: 远处的岩浆湖，是我的路标。
lines.en: A distant lava lake is the only landmark I need.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，火核在响。
lines.en: I stand still, and the flame core ticks.

lines.zh: 灰落在眼窝里，我不擦。
lines.en: Ash settles in my eye sockets; I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 我等着下一阵热风。
lines.en: I wait for the next hot wind.

lines.zh: 岩浆在我脚下慢慢流。
lines.en: Lava crawls slowly past my feet.

lines.zh: 我的裂缝里，偶尔蹦出火星。
lines.en: Sparks jump out of my cracks now and then.

lines.zh: 这片荒地没有别的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing else in this wasteland.

lines.zh: 我用脚掌碾碎一块下界岩。
lines.en: I grind a piece of netherrack under my foot.

lines.zh: 热得连空气都在抖。
lines.en: It is so hot that the air trembles.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，我只需要烧。
lines.en: I do not need food, only something to burn.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我听见石头碎。
lines.en: Something moves; I hear stone breaking.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，衣服在冒烟。
lines.en: You stand there, and your clothes are smoking.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子发出石响。
lines.en: I lower my head; my neck grinds like stone.

lines.zh: 你的汗一出来就干了。
lines.en: Your sweat dries the moment it appears.

lines.zh: 你不该来这片荒地。
lines.en: You should not have come to this wasteland.

lines.zh: 我眼窝里全是火，你看见了。
lines.en: My eye sockets are all fire, and you saw.

lines.zh: 你后退，脚下的岩在碎。
lines.en: You step back, and the rock crumbles under you.

lines.zh: 你在数我的步子，太慢了。
lines.en: You are counting my steps; far too slow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里那把剑。
lines.en: I am watching the sword in your hand.

lines.zh: 你身上有水的味道，很少。
lines.en: You smell of water, and only a little.

lines.zh: 你看了我很久，我也一样。
lines.en: You looked at me a long time; so did I.

lines.zh: 你砍在我关节上，缺口在你那边。
lines.en: Your blade hits my joint, and the notch is yours.

lines.zh: 石头碎了不疼，可火核疼。
lines.en: Broken stone does not hurt, but the core does.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下一块，还在烧。
lines.en: A piece falls off me and keeps burning.

lines.zh: 这一下，灰都震起来了。
lines.en: That blow shook the ash off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我不退，火核让我站着。
lines.en: I do not step back; the core keeps me standing.

lines.zh: 你打裂我胸口，火漏出来。
lines.en: You cracked my chest and fire leaks out.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，里面全是红的。
lines.en: I look down at the wound; it is all red inside.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我会更热。
lines.en: When it hurts, I get hotter.

lines.zh: 你的武器开始发软了。
lines.en: Your weapon is starting to soften.

lines.zh: 石头会碎，火不会。
lines.en: Stone breaks; fire does not.

lines.zh: 你手里的煤，燃烧味很正。
lines.en: The coal in your hand burns with the right smell.

lines.zh: 把那块岩浆膏给我。
lines.en: Hand me that magma cream.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想烧掉它。
lines.en: I will not eat it; I only want to burn it.

lines.zh: 你的木板在响，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your planks are creaking, and I smell them.

lines.zh: 一点火药味，就够我转身。
lines.en: One trace of gunpowder is enough to turn me.

lines.zh: 给我一把烈焰粉，我安静些。
lines.en: Give me blaze powder and I will be quiet.

lines.zh: 那块下界岩是热的，递过来。
lines.en: That netherrack is hot; pass it here.

lines.zh: 我看到火，就走不动了。
lines.en: Once I see a fire, I cannot walk away.

lines.zh: 你点着火把，我当你是同类。
lines.en: Light a torch and I will take you for kin.

lines.zh: 我只要烧的东西，不要人。
lines.en: I want only things that burn, not people.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵烧红的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wall heated red.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀蹭过你，布料焦了。
lines.en: My shoulder brushes you and your cloth chars.

lines.zh: 你退开时，鞋底粘在岩上。
lines.en: As you pull away, your sole sticks to rock.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，灰烬扬起来。
lines.en: I shove you once and the ash rises.

lines.zh: 我的胸口很硬，火核在里面。
lines.en: My chest is hard, and the core burns inside it.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，眉毛会卷。
lines.en: Stand that close and your eyebrows will curl.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的影子，地也陷了。
lines.en: I step on your shadow and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，你就飞了。
lines.en: I raise an arm to block, and you fly.

lines.zh: 我从不闪避，石头不闪避。
lines.en: I never dodge; stone does not dodge.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的手套少了一块。
lines.en: That contact cost you part of a glove.

lines.zh: 两团火核靠近，荒地更亮了。
lines.en: Two flame cores come close and the waste brightens.

lines.zh: 我们不拥抱，我们会熔在一起。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we would melt together.

lines.zh: 她的裂缝比我的深，里面通红。
lines.en: Her cracks run deeper than mine and glow red.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，谁都不动。
lines.en: We stand side by side, and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 火核的节奏，慢慢对上了。
lines.en: Slowly, the rhythm of our cores matches.

lines.zh: 我们交换一小块熔岩。
lines.en: We trade a small piece of lava between us.

lines.zh: 两块黑石相碰，冒出火星。
lines.en: Two blackstones strike and throw sparks.

lines.zh: 荒地太大，能遇到就是运气。
lines.en: The waste is vast; meeting at all is luck.

lines.zh: 她烧得比我稳，我学她。
lines.en: She burns steadier than I do, so I copy her.

lines.zh: 分开时，我们各带走一半热。
lines.en: When we part, we each carry half the heat.

lines.zh: 我把那块煤塞进胸口裂缝。
lines.en: I push that coal into the crack in my chest.

lines.zh: 熔岩块掉在地上，我捡起来。
lines.en: A lava chunk drops, and I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我捡石头，不捡别的。
lines.en: I pick up stones and nothing else.

lines.zh: 这块燧石，我握一下就碎了。
lines.en: That flint shatters the moment I close my hand.

lines.zh: 你的铁镐，我捏成了饼。
lines.en: Your iron pickaxe, I squeezed into a disc.

lines.zh: 我把骨灰捧起来，撒回火里。
lines.en: I scoop up the ashes and scatter them into fire.

lines.zh: 那枚火核碎片，是我的。
lines.en: That shard of flame core is mine.

lines.zh: 我不收藏东西，我只烧掉。
lines.en: I do not collect things; I burn them.

lines.zh: 地上有煤，我就停下来捡。
lines.en: When there is coal on the ground, I stop.

lines.zh: 我捡起的，通常都烧完了。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up is usually burnt by then.

lines.zh: 活的东西在荒地走，太显眼。
lines.en: Living things stand out badly in a wasteland.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，比岩浆响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is louder than the lava.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，脚就自己转过去。
lines.en: Once I have locked on, my feet turn by themselves.

lines.zh: 你身上有水，我要把它烧干。
lines.en: You carry water, and I mean to boil it dry.

lines.zh: 谁离岩浆湖远，我就挑谁。
lines.en: I pick whoever is farthest from the lava lake.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡得住刀，挡不住热。
lines.en: Your armor stops blades but not heat.

lines.zh: 火核指了个方向，我就走。
lines.en: The flame core points a direction, and I walk.

lines.zh: 你跑得越急，灰越乱。
lines.en: The more you run, the more ash you stir.

lines.zh: 我看不见远处，但我感觉得到人。
lines.en: I cannot see far, but I feel people.

lines.zh: 你在换气，我数到第三下。
lines.en: You are breathing; I count to three.

lines.zh: 一个就够，这荒地只留一个。
lines.en: One is enough; this waste keeps only one.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了下界岩，声音很清楚。
lines.en: You cracked netherrack, and the sound was clear.

lines.zh: 我的目标从不改，直到烧完。
lines.en: My target never changes until it burns out.

lines.zh: 现在开始，你走到哪我跟到哪。
lines.en: From now on, wherever you go, I follow.

lines.zh: 你踩在岩浆石上，那石头认得我。
lines.en: You're standing on lava stone. That stone knows me.

lines.zh: 你退的方向，正好是风来的方向。
lines.en: You're backing into the wind. Good.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，火核烧得更旺。
lines.en: I lower my body and the core burns brighter.

lines.zh: 岩浆湖那侧，我堵住了。
lines.en: I have blocked the side toward the lava lake.

lines.zh: 你只能往灰原跑，那里更热。
lines.en: You can only run into the ash fields, hotter still.

lines.zh: 火核在胸前跳，我慢慢逼近。
lines.en: The flame core pulses in my chest as I close in.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，你才看见我。
lines.en: My shadow arrives before you see me.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我已经近了。
lines.en: By the time you turn, I am already close.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，石头自己裂开。
lines.en: I do not go around; the stone splits itself.

lines.zh: 火核的热，让你先出汗。
lines.en: The heat of my core makes you sweat first.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向裂谷边缘。
lines.en: I drive you toward the edge of the ravine.

lines.zh: 距离还有十步，我数着。
lines.en: Ten paces left, and I am counting them.

lines.zh: 你的箭射过来，我不躲。
lines.en: Your arrows come, and I do not dodge.

lines.zh: 灰会把你的脚印留给我。
lines.en: The ash will keep your footprints for me.

lines.zh: 这片荒地我熟，你不熟。
lines.en: I know this wasteland, and you do not.

lines.zh: 我停下，是为了让你以为有机会。
lines.en: I stop so you believe you have a chance.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我的靠近就是话。
lines.en: I don't shout. My approach is the words.

lines.zh: 你身后的下界岩在冒烟。
lines.en: The netherrack behind you is smoking.

lines.zh: 我一拳下去，你的盾凹了。
lines.en: One punch, and your shield dents inward.

lines.zh: 我的拳头带火，伤口会继续烧。
lines.en: My fist carries fire; the wound keeps burning.

lines.zh: 你被砸进下界岩里，卡住了。
lines.en: You are hammered into netherrack and stuck there.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，很烫。
lines.en: I grab your arm, and it is very hot.

lines.zh: 这一下没打中，地上多了个坑。
lines.en: I miss, and the ground gains a new crater.

lines.zh: 我把你举起来，往岩浆那边走。
lines.en: I lift you and carry you toward the lava.

lines.zh: 我的指节裂开，火喷到你脸上。
lines.en: My knuckles split and fire sprays into your face.

lines.zh: 你挡了三次，第四次没挡住。
lines.en: You block three times and miss the fourth.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的腿，听见骨头响。
lines.en: I pin your leg and hear the bone give.

lines.zh: 火星跟着我的拳头走。
lines.en: Sparks travel with every swing of my fist.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁，没有路了。
lines.en: You back into the rock wall, and there is no road.

lines.zh: 我打的时候不说话，只有响。
lines.en: I say nothing when I strike, only the noise.

lines.zh: 你身上的水，正在被烤干。
lines.en: The water on you is being baked away.

lines.zh: 这一拳，够你记一辈子。
lines.en: This punch will last you the rest of your life.

lines.zh: 下界荒地裂开一道缝，我爬出来。
lines.en: A crack opens in the nether waste, and I climb out.

lines.zh: 火核先亮，然后才是身体。
lines.en: The flame core lights first; the body comes after.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆边上站起来，浑身滴火。
lines.en: I rise by the lava, dripping fire.

lines.zh: 这一带只有一个我，够了。
lines.en: There is only one of me here, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 灰烬堆起一个人形，那是我。
lines.en: A heap of ash takes human shape; that is me.

lines.zh: 你听见石头挪动，就是我了。
lines.en: If you hear stone shifting, that is me.

lines.zh: 热风把我吹醒，我睁眼。
lines.en: The hot wind wakes me, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在废地里出生，没有别处。
lines.en: I was born in the waste; there is nowhere else.

lines.zh: 脚下的岩还是软的，我刚成形。
lines.en: The rock under me is still soft; I am new.

lines.zh: 火核跳了一下，我就有了方向。
lines.en: The core ticks once, and I have a direction.

lines.zh: 远处的岩浆湖认得我。
lines.en: The lava lake in the distance knows me.

lines.zh: 我站起来，荒地亮了一点。
lines.en: I stand up, and the waste grows a little brighter.

lines.zh: 火对我不算什么，只是更亮些。
lines.en: Fire means little to me, only more light.

lines.zh: 下界的岩壁太脆，站不住。
lines.en: Nether rock crumbles under me.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，冒白烟，很疼。
lines.en: Water hits me, hissing white, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，火核还在跳。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, but the core still ticks.

lines.zh: 箭扎进缝里，烧成了灰。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in a crack and burns to ash.

lines.zh: 紫光压住火核，我第一次发冷。
lines.en: Violet light smothers my core and I feel cold.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可没煤火会小。
lines.en: I do not eat, but without coal my fire shrinks.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，火核亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my core burns blinding.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有热，火核快灭了。
lines.en: No heat in the void; my core is going out.
